dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 6b Woodlands.  Woodlands are treed areas that provide important environmental, ecological, and recreational benefits. They contribute to biodiversity, wildlife habitat, air quality, carbon sequestration, and the overall health and connectivity of the Natural Heritage System.
This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
